import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import { createHmac } from 'node:crypto'
import { createServer } from 'node:http'
import * as Sentry from '@sentry/node'
import { createRequestListener } from 'remix/node-fetch-server'

const envelopes = []
const collector = createServer(async (req, res) => {
  let body = ''
  for await (const chunk of req) body += chunk
  envelopes.push(body)
  res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*')
  res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Headers', '*')
  res.end('{}')
})
await new Promise((resolve) => collector.listen(3094, '127.0.0.1', resolve))
process.env.NODE_ENV = 'production'
process.env.INNGEST_EVENT_KEY = 'local-runtime-event-key'
process.env.INNGEST_SIGNING_KEY = 'signkey-test-' + 'ab'.repeat(32)
process.env.SENTRY_DSN = 'http://public@127.0.0.1:3094/1'
process.env.REMIX_SENTRY_DSN = process.env.SENTRY_DSN
Sentry.init({ dsn: process.env.SENTRY_DSN, defaultIntegrations: false })
const { router } = await import('./src/router.tsx')
const application = createServer(createRequestListener((request) => router.fetch(request)))
await new Promise((resolve) => application.listen(3095, '127.0.0.1', resolve))
const { captureServerError } = await import('./src/server/observability.ts')
captureServerError(new Error('Native server integration review'))
assert.equal(await Sentry.flush(5000), true)
assert.ok(envelopes.some((body) => body.includes('Native server integration review')))
const config = await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:3095/api/client-config')
assert.equal((await config.json()).sentryDsn, process.env.REMIX_SENTRY_DSN)
const info = await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:3095/api/inngest')
assert.equal(info.status, 401)
const payload = JSON.stringify({
  event: {
    name: 'app/example',
    data: { id: 'customer-review-2026' },
    ts: Date.now(),
    id: 'event_review',
  },
  events: [],
  steps: {},
  ctx: {
    run_id: '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001',
    attempt: 0,
    stack: { stack: [], current: 0 },
    disable_immediate_execution: false,
    use_api: false,
  },
})
const timestamp = String(Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000))
const key = 'ab'.repeat(32)
const canonicalize = (value) =>
  Array.isArray(value)
    ? value.map(canonicalize)
    : value && typeof value === 'object'
      ? Object.fromEntries(
          Object.keys(value)
            .sort()
            .map((key) => [key, canonicalize(value[key])]),
        )
      : value
const signature = createHmac('sha256', key)
  .update(JSON.stringify(canonicalize(JSON.parse(payload))))
  .update(timestamp)
  .digest('hex')
const signed = await fetch(
  'http://127.0.0.1:3095/api/inngest?fnId=customer-portal-example&stepId=step',
  {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      'content-type': 'application/json',
      'x-inngest-signature': `t=${timestamp}&s=${signature}`,
    },
    body: payload,
  },
)
const body = await signed.text()
assert.equal(signed.status, 206)
assert.ok(body.includes('customer-review-2026'))
await (await import('./src/assets.ts')).assets.close()
await Sentry.close(1000)
await new Promise((resolve) => application.close(resolve))
await new Promise((resolve) => collector.close(resolve))
